sentences.text: This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.481/2023 registered at Police Station Shujalpur Mandi, District Shajapur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 406, 420, 467 and 468 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 01/11/2023.
2. After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present bail application.
3. Accordingly, the first bail application preferred under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. stands dismissed as withdrawn.
